Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Shift the grid contents down by one row, filling the top with background."""
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[bg] * len(grid[0])] + [list(row) for row in grid[:-1]]
